info.title: J2meNXX
info.author: Tô Quang Thắng
info.details: J2ME (Java ME / MIDP 2.0) emulator for Nintendo Switch, written in C with devkitPro + SDL2. Custom Java VM that runs old mobile phone .jar games directly on Switch: 2D/3D (M3G) graphics, MIDI/WAV/MP3 audio, HTTP/HTTPS/socket networking, RMS save data.\n\n

changelog:
v0.8.12
J2ME-NXX v0.8.12

- Support Russian and Chinese (Simplified): choose 简体中文 or Русский in Settings → System → Language, or on the first-run language screen. Java apps also receive the matching locale (zh-CN / ru-RU).
